description.value: A 24-month observational study of older smokers and never smokers examining cognitive decline and longitudinal gray matter density changes associated with smoking cessation.

spans.text: We conducted a 3-month non-randomized trial of smoking cessation and a 24-month observational study of community-dwelling older adults living in the metropolitan area of Perth, Australia, between 2003 and 2006.

value: We hypothesized that cessation of smoking by chronic smokers reduces the rate of cognitive decline and brain atrophy over 2 years compared with non-smokers.
